defensiveAbilities.name: Attunement Aura
defensiveAbilities.description: 60 feet. All allied creatures in the aura gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speeds (if the dragon is photon-attuned), or all enemies take a –5-foot status penalty to Speeds (if the dragon is graviton-attuned).

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cosmic Attunement
offensiveAbilities.description:
The cosmic dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. The dragon's melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 Fire Damage damage while they're photon-attuned and an additional 1d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage plus Knockdown while they're graviton-attuned. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is likewise determined by their current attunement, as are the effects of some of their other abilities. The dragon can choose to exclude any creatures from any effect of the aura or action that uses the aura.

The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Stellar Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stellar Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing 10d10 Spirit Damage damage in a 40ft Type:cone (Basic DC 34 Will Saving Throw save). The dragon can't use Stellar Breath for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stellar Mote
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon conjures a mote of stellar energy that shares their current attunement. They direct the mote to a square within 90 feet. While the mote is deployed, the dragon's attunement aura also emanates from that square, with the same emanation radius. The dragon can Sustain to move the mote up to 90 feet or to recall the mote from any distance. The mote is made of cosmic energy, doesn't occupy a space, and can't be targeted or destroyed by any effect.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stellar Pulse
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon imposes an effect on creatures within their attunement aura. The effect is based on the dragon's current attunement. The dragon can't use Stellar Pulse again for 1d4 rounds.

  • Graviton Each creature must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Immobilized for 1 round.

  • Photon Each creature becomes Quickened and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

lv3spells.name: Life Seal (at will)
lv3spells.description:
Trigger A creature within range enters an environment that would be harmful to it.

A shimmering bubble envelops the target's body, allowing it to breathe normally in a vacuum or other unsafe environment and protecting it from severe temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 5 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts for 8 hours and also protects against extreme temperatures and radiation.

Heightened (10th) You can target up to 10 additional creatures to gain protection against the environment the triggering creature entered. The spell lasts until your next daily preparations and also protects against incredible temperatures and radiation.

lv5spells.name: Sending
lv5spells.description: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.

lv5spells.name: Truespeech (constant)
lv5spells.description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

lv7spells.name: Eclipse Burst
lv7spells.description:
A globe of freezing darkness explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 cold damage to creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d4 void damage to living creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, eclipse burst attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes Blinded by the darkness for an unlimited duration.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d10 and the void damage against the living increases by 1d4.

lv7spells.name: Sunburst
lv7spells.description:
A powerful globe of searing sunlight explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 fire damage to all creatures in the area, plus an additional (@item.level+1)d10 Vitality Damage damage to undead creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes Blinded permanently.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical darkness, sunburst attempts to counteract the darkness effect.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d10, and the vitality damage against undead increases by 1d10.
